newsitem.title: UK: Granada seen higher after final results.
newsitem.headline: Granada seen higher after final results.

text.p: Shares in leisure and media conglomerate Granada Group Plc were expected to open higher on Wednesday after annual pretax profit beat analysts expectations.
The shares closed at 892-1/2p on Tuesday.
By 0800 GMT the shares were indicated up 9p at 901-1/2p.
Pretax profits excluding exceptional items jumped 37 percent to 480 million stg, beating analysts forecasts of between 451-46 million stg. Turnover rose by 60 percent to 3.82 billion stg.

Granada also repeated that it expects to complete its sale of the Exclusive hotels division by early next year and added that the group was on track to improve Forte's profits by over 100 million stg from 1996/97.
